title: Iran tone z<-1.5 -> XLE 1d
hypothesis: R2 | [oil-shipping] Iran GDELT tone 10d z-score below -1.5 (sharply negative) leads XLE log returns by 1 day (+); trade long XLE 3d [gdelt.irn.tone -> finance.XLE.log_return]
message: Not supported: Iran tone z<-1.5 vs XLE r=-0.09 (n=390); best lag -2d r=-0.13; heuristic trade rule flipped to tone z>1 long XLE 1d (hit 65%, OOS hit 50%)

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.irn.tone rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long XLE next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
